Void Resistance is one of the Defenses which mitigates Void Damage during Combat Calculations.

## Contents

- 1 Value

- 2 Calculations

- 2.1 Shred

- 2.2 Base mitigation

- 2.3 Enemy penetration

## Value[]

Void Resistance is a percentage value with no upper limit.

By calculations, it is negatively affected by Shred and natural enemy penetration. It is possible for Void Resistance to go negative, increasing incoming void damage.

{\displaystyle TotalResistance=\min(75\%,\%_{Resistance}-3\%*n_{ShredStacks})-n_{zoneLevel}\%}

### Shred[]

Void Shred stacks reduce Void Resistance by 3% each.

### Base mitigation[]

Up to 75% of resistance is used for base mitigation, any leftover portion is ignored.

### Enemy penetration[]

Enemies naturally penetrate 1% of resistance per area level, up to 75%.
